track: T3 - video along-track / lateral truth at inside kerbs (clipping points)

evidenceClass.measured: video pixel events (edge pixel u, frame PTS, sub-frame tip time) and their lap-time conversion
evidenceClass.derived: replay predictions through the camera model; video-minus-replay offsets; between-lap deviations
evidenceClass.estimated: absolute metres (lateral distance, forward distance D, along-track metres): depend on the self-calibrated camera (h, f*h), a flat/CG road surface and no lens-distortion model

timeBase.videoPts: ffmpeg PTS (s), CFR 30 fps, frame k at k/30 s; frames decoded with accurate input seek
timeBase.lapTime: T = PTS - lapStartPts; lapStartPts from artifacts/video-position-gap-2026-10-02/video-timer-reads.json (reference lap start + per-lap overlay-timer correction). Replay lap t = T - meta.first_sample_after_lap_start_seconds.
timeBase.overlayTimerLag: the overlay timer reads trail truth by 0-50 ms; the mapping inherits this, so the replay events placed into video time are about 0.025 +- 0.015 s too late. dt below is NOT corrected for it (add about +0.025 s to dt for the timer-lag-corrected value).

definitions.row: fixed image row (pixels, 1280x720). Primary reference row 276; rows 264 and 286 reported as checks. At a fixed row the camera sees the road at a fixed forward distance D (car-fixed; flat-road value per camera below).
definitions.edge: road-side edge of the inside kerb (white strip / paint = kerb_zones paint line) at the row, by colour classification
definitions.tip: clipping-point event: the time the kerb edge reaches its extreme position toward the image centre at the row, i.e. the minimum lateral camera-to-kerb distance at forward distance D (task item 3). Sub-frame by parabola (+-3 frames).
definitions.redOn: leading end of the red kerb blocks crossing the row in open view (task item 1, leading end)
definitions.redOff: trailing end of the red kerb blocks leaving the row in open view (task item 1, trailing end)
definitions.dt: video event time minus the replay-predicted time of the same event (s). Negative = the video shows the event earlier than the 3DCG replay (replay late / behind).
definitions.replayMinusVideoAlongM: dt * replay speed (m): along-track position of the replay minus the true (video) position at the event; negative = replay behind
definitions.dX: video minus replay lateral position of the kerb edge at the tip, camera frame (m, right +)
definitions.dDistance: video minus replay lateral camera-to-kerb distance at the tip (m); positive = in reality the car was farther from the kerb than the replay shows
definitions.replayPrediction: camera rigidly on the replay pose (registered GPS reference point, camera 0.55 m behind, 0 m lateral, heading = GPS course as in the viewer), CG road surface heights (track.json altLeft/altRight) for the car pitch/roll and the kerb points, kerb_zones paint line (CG road edge beyond the kerb) and block line

nominal.label: f967_h1.26
nominal.status: estimated (self-calibrated from the video + logger; not a lens calibration)

vanishingPoint.note: 7/30 main straight, white road-edge lines; used for both days (dashboard edge at the same pixels on both days); 7/29 wet fits too few/unstable

heightFromRoadWidth.note: camber-corrected (track.json cross slope ~ -3 %); flat-road estimate 1.47-1.51 m is implausible for a camera inside a Mazda2

value.note: parallax biases left-hand corners high and right-hand corners low in this window; the mean of the two is the estimate, half their difference a rough uncertainty

fTimesHFromRowTiming.source: summarize.py (tip offsets at rows 252-286 vs D(row)/speed, within-pass demeaned, bootstrap over passes)
fTimesHFromRowTiming.note: self-consistent where Dscale = 1. A wrong f*h makes the tip offset depend on the row.

acrossKerbSpread.note: alternative scale criterion: if the replay error at the clipping points were one common clock offset, the right camera scale would minimise the spread of the per-kerb median tip dt; that spread (summary.<race>.cameraSensitivity.*.acrossKerbSdOfMedianTipDt) is smallest for f*h about 700-1000 and grows above 1200, i.e. it prefers a smaller scale than the row-timing scan. Kerb-specific errors (kerb_zones stations, local GPS, body pitch at each corner) can produce either result.

evidence.combinedScale: f*h about 1100 +- 250 px m (D at row 276 about 14 +- 3 m); nominal 1218 is the upper-central value

profile20261003.note: camera-profile.json (Codex fit) used unmodified (profile_check.py). Its f is not supported by the rotation check (~930 px) or the row-timing scan (f*h ~1200), but it gives a small across-kerb spread.

straightLateralCheck.definition: main straight 380-680 m: video camera-to-left-road-edge distance from the two edge-line slopes and the road width (camber-corrected), minus the replay camera position relative to the CG left road edge; per-frame differences, median per lap. Not at kerbs; a second lateral truth source.

suspectKerbs.rule: kerb median |dDistance| > 2.0 m at the tip: implausible against the known ~0.5-1 m lateral GPS error, so the video edge and the kerb_zones/CG line are probably different painted features (e.g. the 1st-corner painted apex area, the Dunlop-right wedge); excluded below

perLapCommonOffset.definition: per lap, median over kerbs/events of (dt - kerb median dt): a lap-wide timing offset of the replay vs the video that the per-kerb medians do not remove (e.g. an error in the overlay-timer correction of that lap)
perLapCommonOffset.note: If the per-lap overlay-timer corrections were replaced by one session-mean correction, the lap-wide offsets would become offsetMinusCorrectionDeviationS (spread 0.012 s RMS about their mean): the kerb events do not support lap-to-lap differences in the timer correction (e.g. 7/30 L5 +0.09 s).

suspectKerbs.rule: kerb median |dDistance| > 2.0 m at the tip: implausible against the known ~0.5-1 m lateral GPS error, so the video edge and the kerb_zones/CG line are probably different painted features (e.g. the 1st-corner painted apex area, the Dunlop-right wedge); excluded below

perLapCommonOffset.definition: per lap, median over kerbs/events of (dt - kerb median dt): a lap-wide timing offset of the replay vs the video that the per-kerb medians do not remove (e.g. an error in the overlay-timer correction of that lap)
perLapCommonOffset.note: If the per-lap overlay-timer corrections were replaced by one session-mean correction, the lap-wide offsets would become offsetMinusCorrectionDeviationS (spread 0.012 s RMS about their mean): the kerb events do not support lap-to-lap differences in the timer correction (e.g. 7/30 L5 +0.09 s).
